**nano.md 0.3.0 — pick up where you left off**

- **Window placement:** the window opens at the size and position you
  closed it at, maximized if it was. If that monitor is gone, it comes
  back on one that's connected.
- **Reading position:** a recent file reopens in the view you left it in,
  rendered or raw, and at the same scroll position.

**Install:** download the archive for your platform below;
`SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all of them. Binaries are still unsigned, so
SmartScreen and Gatekeeper warn on first launch; the README's Install
section covers both.

**Platforms:** Windows x86_64, macOS arm64 and x86_64 (real `.app`
bundle), Linux x86_64 (glibc 2.35+, built on ubuntu-22.04).

Full changelog in [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/odysseia06/nanomd/blob/v0.3.0/CHANGELOG.md).
